title: Townsend Brown: worse than a thermonuclear bomb

tellings.quote: there's one line from a biography of Towns and Brown, you know, this Paul Schatzkin book, The Man Who Mastered Gravity, where it's you know, uh this will make a thermonuclear bomb look like a child's firecracker.

plain: A biography of the scientist Thomas Townsend Brown, the book The Man Who Mastered Gravity by Paul Schatzkin, contains a line saying Brown's work "will make a thermonuclear bomb look like a child's firecracker." Michels quotes the line himself, from memory, to show how powerful Brown's gravity research was thought to be.
